# Plan: OptimalX ship program 2026-09-21 (S1..S6 parallel builders, one working tree, then S7)

Companion to `CONDUCTOR-2026-09-21.md` (state, doctrine, rules). Written by the planner, adopted by the conductor with the amendments in §0.

## 0. Conductor amendments (read first)

- The taxonomy is 25 nodes: 10 type roots + 5 protein children + 4 utility + 6 goals. The conductor file's "25 categories + 6 goals" was a miscount.
- The home registers 16 blocks (`app/components/home/defaults.ts:37-63`), not twelve.
- Gate status: the `faq_3_a` diacritic (owner commit 9d8a70e) was removed by the conductor at T0; `pnpm check:copy` is 0 again. S4 still owns the compliant rewrite and its reporting.
- Locale concurrency rule (replaces Contract D's "any builder may run i18n:merge"): **only the conductor runs `pnpm i18n:merge`**, at the checkpoints. S1/S2/S3/S6 write each new key identically into their own partial AND into `locales/ar.json` / `locales/en.json` (the established B7 convention; `tests/i18n.test.ts` only forbids a partial that redefines a base value with a different value). Do the base insertion ONCE, at the end of your batch, as a single edit per file, to keep the write window on `ar.json` small. S4 edits existing values in the declaring partial first, then base, and never opens `tax.*`, `s2.*`, `seo.*`, `s6.*`.
- Machine load rule: six builders share one laptop and one vite dev server. Run targeted test files while working (`pnpm vitest run tests/<dir>`), the full `pnpm test` once at the end, `pnpm build` once at the end, `pnpm typecheck` when a type surface changes. Never start a second preview server.
- S5 credentials: the app's `client_id`/`client_secret` are already in the conductor's hands (Partners MCP); the conductor writes them to `.env.salla` (gitignored by the existing `.env.*` rule). The script reads `SALLA_CLIENT_ID` / `SALLA_CLIENT_SECRET` from the environment or from `.env.salla` with a hand parser; it never prints either.
- Owner decisions taken by the conductor under the mandate (the owner can overrule): the six "decisions with defaults" in §5 stand; the `faq_3_a` compliant rewrite is APPLIED by S4 and recorded old→new with the reason in `docs/content/changes-2026-09-21.md` (not silently: the owner sees every line).

## 2. Batches

### Shared contracts (published at T0; each batch codes against them)

**Contract A: `app/content/taxonomy.json`** (S1 owns; S5 and the fixture generator read it):
```json
{ "nodes": [ { "key": "whey_protein", "slug": "whey-protein", "scope": "type|goal|utility",
  "parent": "protein|null", "order": 2, "skus": ["OX-001", "..."], "image_sku": "OX-001" } ] }
```
Names never live here: `ox.tax.<key>.name` / `.description` in `locales/partials/tax.{ar,en}.json` (S1). Existing `ox.content.categories.<key>.*` and `ox.content.goals.<key>.*` keys stay as they are.

**Contract B: `app/content/taxonomy.ts`** (S1):
```ts
export type TaxonomyScope = 'type' | 'goal' | 'utility';
export interface TaxonomyNode { key; slug; scope; parent: string | null; order; icon: OxIconName;
  nameKey; h1Key; titleKey; descriptionKey; introKey; faq: {qKey; aKey}[]; skus: string[]; imageSku?: string }
export const TAXONOMY: TaxonomyNode[]; export function nodeBySlug(slug?: string): TaxonomyNode | undefined;
export function childrenOf(slug: string): TaxonomyNode[]; export const MENU: { types; goals; utility };
```
`categories.ts` and `goals.ts` keep their exports (S2/S3 code reads them today) and gain `descriptionKey` and `nameKey`.

**Contract C: `app/components/listing/useTaxonomyLinks.ts`** (S1):
```ts
export interface TaxonomyLink { slug; label; to; resolved: boolean; icon; count?: number; image?: string; children: TaxonomyLink[] }
export function useTaxonomyLinks(): { types; goals; utility; bySlug(slug): TaxonomyLink | undefined; isLoading }
```
Resolution order: `category.queries.list()` (flattened with `sub_categories`) matched by `matchesSlug(url, slug)` or by id from `app/content/taxonomy-ids.ts` (generated, see S5) → `menu.queries.header()` → `searchFallback(t(h1Key))`. `useHeaderMenu().goals` becomes an adapter over it so `OxGoals` (S2) keeps working unchanged.

**Contract D: locale files.** New keys this program go ONLY to new partials: `tax.*` (S1), `s2.*` (S2), `seo.*` (S3), `s6.*` (S6), each key ALSO written identically into base (see §0). S4 owns every pre-existing file under `locales/` and never opens the four new pairs. Partials are the source of truth for merge (`scripts/i18n-merge.mjs:76-80` overwrites base with partial values). Only the conductor runs `pnpm i18n:merge`.

**Contract E: route files split.** S3 owns the head-bearing content routes: `app/routes/{index,$slug.c$id,$slug.p$id,search,brands,brands.$id,$slug.brand-$id,offers,latest-products,most-sales-products,$slug.tag-$id,tags.$id,blog,blog_.*,$slug.page-$id}.tsx` plus `app/components/{pages,commerce}/head.ts`. S1 owns the new `app/routes/categories.tsx`. S6 owns every other route file (`about, contact, services, branch, tools.converter, thankyou.$orderId, cart, account.*, loyalty, testimonials, pending-orders, kitchen-sink, __root`).

**Contract F: `twilight.json`.** S2 alone edits `components[]` entries for `home.ox-categories`, `home.ox-goals`, `home.ox-brands`, `home.ox-newsletter` (and `defaults.ts` + `tests/home/defaults.test.ts` in lockstep). `settings[]` is frozen until S7.

Builds on: `docs/build/salla-ids.json` (SKU → id), `fixtures/store/products.json` (image URLs for category images), Contract A JSON + `tax.*.json` names, `scripts/gen-salla-ids.mjs` (pattern), Salla Merchant API v2 (`https://api.salla.dev/admin/v2`; categories: `name, parent_id, metadata_title, metadata_description, metadata_url (seo slug), image`; brands: `name, description, logo`; products: `PUT /admin/v2/products/{id}` with `categories[]`, `brand_id`: verify each field against the current Salla docs before coding; the conductor has Context7 and the Salla Partners MCP and answers doc questions through the progress file).
Steps: (1) `salla-auth.mjs`: reads `SALLA_CLIENT_ID/SECRET` from env or `.env.salla` (hand parser, no dotenv); starts `http://localhost:8787/callback` bound to 127.0.0.1; prints the authorize URL (`https://accounts.salla.sa/oauth2/auth`, `response_type=code`, `scope=offline_access`, random `state`); verifies `state`; exchanges at `https://accounts.salla.sa/oauth2/token`; writes `.salla-token.json` `{access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, scope}`; `--refresh`; `SALLA_ACCESS_TOKEN` env overrides the file (sandbox path); never logs a token. (2) `salla-categories.mjs --plan|--apply [--brands] [--assign] [--images]`: idempotent by `metadata_url` then name; creates parents before children; brands from FINAL-catalogue §B (Latin API name, Arabic description line); assigns each product `categories = [leaf, parent?, goals...]`, `brand_id`; sets category `image` to the `image_sku` product's cdn image if the API accepts a URL (else runbook step); 300 ms spacing, 429 backoff, read-back GET per write with a diff; appends `docs/build/store-write-log.md`; writes `docs/build/taxonomy-ids.json` `{slug: id}`; `--rollback <run-id>` deletes what that run created and restores product category arrays from the pre-write read-back stored in the log. (3) Runbook: preflight (owner installs app 755989931 on store 1888890798 with `categories.read_write, brands.read_write, products.read_write`; redirect URL registered by the conductor), local run, sandbox run (when `api.salla.dev` challenges this IP), dashboard alternative (25 categories with SEO URL = slug; 47 assignments; brands), verification, rollback.
Accept: unit tests with injected `fetch`: plan orders parents first, idempotency skips existing slugs, SKU map covers all 47, parent expansion, token file shape, state mismatch rejected; `git check-ignore .salla-token.json` true; `--plan` output lists 25 categories, the brands, 47 assignments with no network; after `--apply`: read-back shows 25 categories with `metadata_url` = slug, 47 products with expected category ids, log appended, `taxonomy-ids.json` written.
Risk: HIGH (store writes, token handling). Gates: G1 (token path, secrets, redirect binding to 127.0.0.1 only, state check, no token in logs), G3.

## 4. Sequencing and the critical path

```
T0        six builders start. S1 step 1 (contracts) is the first deliverable (30 min).
T0+30m    S3 wires titles/descriptions; S5 consumes taxonomy.json; S1 fixture overlay ready -> conductor restarts preview with OFFLINE_TAXONOMY=1 in a quiet window.
T0+2h     checkpoint 1: conductor runs pnpm i18n:merge, pnpm test, check:all; G1 review of salla-auth.mjs starts.
T0+4h     checkpoint 2: merge; G2 (S2 home, S6 pages) screenshots at 390/1440; S5 --plan reviewed.
T0+6h     freeze: S4 final sweep and changes file; merge; G3 across S1/S3/S4.
T0+6.5h   S7: build, DEPLOY walk, twilight.json settings, docs, push.
Owner     app install consent -> S5 --apply -> gen taxonomy ids -> rebuild -> Partners submit.
```
Critical path: S1 contracts → S3 titles + S5 script → merge → S7 build. S5's live write is off the theme's critical path (the theme falls back to search links) but on the "sell with categories" path; it is blocked by the owner's OAuth consent.

## 5. Top ten risks and decisions

1. **Gate red at HEAD** (fixed at T0; S4 keeps it green).
2. **Salla SEO URL not settable via API** (category `metadata_url` rejected or auto-slugged from Arabic): S5 read-back asserts `metadata_url`; S1 resolves by id through `taxonomy-ids.ts` as the second key; runbook dashboard step.
3. **Owner OAuth consent unavailable this session**: `--plan` and tests ship regardless; runbook has the dashboard path; the theme is deployable without categories (search fallbacks), goal pages and the menu tree degraded until then.
4. **Concurrent edits on `locales/ar.json`**: §0 rule (single base insertion per batch at the end; only the conductor merges).
5. **SSR head throw = 500 page**: every builder guarded by `tryOriginOf`, fixtures include null/empty cases, `pnpm preview` walk in S7.
6. **Parent listing may not include child products** on Salla: S5 assigns leaf and parent; read-back counts.
7. **Layout shift from S2's re-measured blocks**: heights re-measured with data present; G2 CLS probe.
8. **Header overflow regression** at 1024-1440: `fitCount` test with measured widths; browser check at 1024, 1280, 1440.
9. **Claims drift in new copy**: `check-claims.mjs` runs over partials too; S4 reviews S1/S2/S3 partials before the freeze (findings as requests).
10. **Preview restart window**: one scheduled restart at ~T0+45m with `OFFLINE_TAXONOMY=1`; until then S1/S3 verify with unit tests and SSR curls of routes that do not need categories.

Decisions with defaults (proceeding unless the owner overrules):
- "الخطط الغذائية" leaves the header/footer (contradicts the services disclaimer); replaced by taxonomy items.
- "بأفضل سعر" leaves the 14 titles in favour of "أصلي في السعودية" (S4 applies; recorded in the changes file).
- Brand spellings in copy follow the search evidence (§7.1); live product names are not renamed by us.
- Category card images = the store's own product photos via the category `image` field (S5) / overlay (S1); the owner's generated mockups drop in by replacing the category image in the dashboard.
- `free_shipping_threshold` default becomes empty until the dashboard shipping rule exists.
- Newsletter stays gated (`show_newsletter=false`) unless S2 finds a native Twilight subscribe endpoint.
- `faq_3_a`: the compliant rewrite is applied by S4 and recorded (old, new, reason).
